description: This file contains unit tests for database migrations in an Android application using Room and SQLite. It defines a MigrationTest class with test methods for validating migration logic between different database schema versions, including data integrity and default values.

classes.name: MigrationTest
classes.description: Test class for validating database migration scripts in an Android app using Room.

methods.name: migrate1To2
methods.description: Tests migration from database version 1 to 2 by inserting sample data and verifying the addition of 'lastModified' column with default value.

methods.name: migrate2To3
methods.description: Tests migration from database version 2 to 3 by inserting data with 'lastModified', and verifying new columns 'isSynced' and 'syncError' are correctly added and initialized.

methods.name: migrate3To4
methods.description: Tests migration from database version 3 to 4 by verifying default notification preferences entries in the 'notification_preferences' table.
